publication.title: Efficient Self-Supervised Adaptation of 3D Abdominal Vision-Language Model for Institution-Specific HCC Classification via Full Fine-Tuning and PEFT

sources.primary_authority: The accepted paper takes precedence for reported experimental values; the official code supplies optimizer mechanics that the paper does not fully enumerate.
sources.adaptation_note: This profile carries the authors' image ConvLoRA and layer-wise optimizer settings into the present five-class supervised image-only task. It intentionally omits the unavailable text branch and contrastive objective and therefore is not an exact reproduction of the publication.

paper_exact.adapter_lr: Appendix C, Table 6 and accompanying text report a PEFT learning rate of 1e-4.
paper_exact.early_stopping_patience: Appendix C, Table 6 reports patience 5, selected by validation F1.
paper_exact.min_lr_factor: Appendix C reports cosine learning-rate decay to zero.
paper_exact.gradient_checkpointing: Appendix C reports gradient checkpointing for the image and text encoders. This profile requests it; each run records the modules on which the installed Merlin implementation actually enables it.
paper_exact.conv_lora_rank: Table 2 and Appendix C report image ConvLoRA rank 2.
paper_exact.conv_lora_alpha: Table 2 and Appendix C report image ConvLoRA scaling factor 2.

official_code_backed.image_layer_decay: The audited optimizer constructs image-layer learning rates with a layer-wise decay factor of 0.7.
official_code_backed.encoder_weight_decay: The audited training code uses AdamW weight decay 0.01.
official_code_backed.exclude_norm_bias_from_weight_decay: The audited optimizer excludes biases and normalization-like one-dimensional parameters from weight decay.
official_code_backed.warmup_epochs: The audited training code supplies zero warmup steps.
official_code_backed.max_grad_norm: The audited training loop performs no gradient clipping; zero disables it here.

supervised_image_only_adaptations.head_lr: The publication trains projection layers rather than this five-class head; the reported PEFT base learning rate is used for the head.
supervised_image_only_adaptations.head_weight_decay: Eligible classifier matrices receive the official 0.01 decay and classifier normalization/bias parameters receive zero decay.
supervised_image_only_adaptations.dropout_prob: Zero avoids adding classifier dropout not reported by the publication.
supervised_image_only_adaptations.train_image_projection: False is deliberate: Merlin(ImageEmbedding=True) supplies the raw 2048-dimensional image feature and bypasses the publication's contrastive projection.
supervised_image_only_adaptations.scheduler_step_unit: The cosine schedule advances after each real optimizer update, rather than each minibatch, so gradient accumulation has valid schedule semantics.
supervised_image_only_adaptations.embedding_dim: The classifier consumes Merlin's 2048-dimensional image representation.
supervised_image_only_adaptations.min_delta: Zero represents strict improvement in this project's validation-selection metric.

known_methodological_differences: The publication's complete PEFT method also has text LoRA rank 16, alpha 32, and dropout 0.2; this variant has no text encoder training.
The publication trains a joint image-text VLM with InfoNCE and a learned temperature; this variant trains a class-weighted supervised five-class cross-entropy objective.
The publication trains a 512-dimensional contrastive image projection; this variant deliberately uses Merlin's raw 2048-dimensional image embedding and a classifier head.
The official scheduler advances per minibatch. This variant advances after successful optimizer updates so accumulation and AMP-overflow skips do not shorten the cosine schedule.
The publication stops on validation F1. This project retains its common selection protocol, 0.7*macro-F1 + 0.3*balanced accuracy, for comparability across all three strategies.
This variant normalizes accumulated losses and flushes a final partial accumulation window; the audited publication code does neither consistently.
The publication uses FP16 mixed precision. Supply --amp to match that runtime setting.
